svg.title: Placeholder sample COA - AN-7K9Q-2M4X
svg.desc: Single-page portrait sample report with placeholder fields, results and analytical figures, and the Dylan Greene handwritten signature at the lower left. COA Lookup Code AN-7K9Q-2M4X. A product image appears beside the analytical result placeholders.
